In it's current stage the game is only good for hotlapping, but it's not even good at that because there is no way to turn off the damage. Graphically it is lacking compared to ACR (for example), it has it's moments but most of the time the visual bugs and glitches make my eyes hurt. The FFB is too heavy and too numb at the same time with very little detail when braking. The way the assists in GT3 cars work is very strange because even with max TC it feels like it is on minimum. The game also sounds horrible. It has gotten a bit better after this update but it is still very bad, I would say worse than some AC mods. Along with all of that the career has been basically cancelled along with the free roam (for which most people bought the game) has been moved to release, with most of the problems not being fixed it is seeming like the final release either won't be happening for a very long time or it will be as buggy as bad as the game in it's current state.

All in all, if you are planning on having fun in the game in it's current state, you will be disappointed (in my opinion and experience as of the 0.6 update).

Here to join the "it's rough around the edges, but it's early access" crowd. The game has a long way to go but nobody should have expected it to be perfect with so much on the roadmap until v1.0.

The Good:
- Driving physics feel awesome with each car handling uniquely
- Car graphics inside and out are extremely detailed
- Track graphics and sound effects look and sound realistic
- The PRICE! Kunos giving us this game so cheap in early access is a huge service to fans of the franchise. People don't seem to realize they've bought the full game, and are mad they they "paid for a demo". You get the full game at v1.0 for $32. Chill.

The Less Good:
- Early server issues are to be expected
- Controls for a racing sim setup were far more difficult than they should be (took me about 20 mins to get basic controls programmed correctly)
- Menus feel clunky, despite looking good
- AI drivers occasionally forget you're on the road and crash right into you
- Cockpit camera occasionally jumps around

Rooting for the Kunos team as I know the final product will be one of the best for the sim racing community.
I really like the game and I'm certain it will be great. Its hard to go back to the original AC for me :)

Still a little rough around the edges, and missing some features, but I'm looking forward to future updates. Great driving physics, decent selection of cars and tracks, and you can set up some marginally fun races with you and some friends.

However, in the middle all the broken promises, this is the best Assetto Corsa, if not the best sim, to date.
It's the ultimate purist racing sim imo.. There is no better sim out there when it comes to realism... I love the challenge that this realism brings.

Right, so I think it's time I wrote a review even after only 2 hours of gameplay, it's stellar, absolutely fantastic, that's coming from a guy who's sunk thousands of ours into Assetto Corsa and ACC, having done so much racing and hot laps, but obviously it's not fully ready to go (that's why it's in Early Access you knob heads), so although it's playable and feels good, if you decide to buy and play the game don't expect too much with it only being version 0.2.2, there's still a long road ahead so take the opportunity to play the game as it is and send feedback to the devs, that's the whole reason why it's early access.

Basically, don't be afraid to play it based on illogical reviews saying it's but will get better, just play it for yourself and if you don't like it now, just keep it and let updates roll out, but if you're unwilling to do that, just refund it and wait for version 1.0.0 to release.

I'd also really like if you could choose what kind of manual gearbox to drive on, stick shift or steering wheel paddles. Because I really f**king hate shifting with the wheel paddles. Makes me a worse driver.

I honestly don't know why everyone is complaining about not being able to run the game, you don't need to run the game max graphics. This is a very demanding game and you should expect it not to run as good on 4K ultra settings, you'll be fine playing 1080P medium graphics.

The only issue I'm experiencing is with my force feedback on my G920, this kind of ruins the whole point of driving if I can't feel when my car is under-steering or over-steering. Another problem being the online mode not being available, I mean I understand the game was just released but I feel like the devs should've been prepared for this and had the server up and running. I hope these issues get resolved soon but other than that this is a really solid game and I'm looking forward to up coming updates.

I really wanted to like AC EVO but so far I really don't like the FFB, and I've tried over 26 hr with different game seetings, or Moza pithouse to make it better with no success. The FFB in this game is basically aligment force with extremly damped feeling of the road. From IRL experince on track driving cars like Porsche 992 GT3 and Mclaren Artura, sports cars have very rigid suspension you feel like you're sitting direclty on the road, you feel every imperfiction. Cars in AC Evo drive closer to my Ford truck vague steering and not connected to road with lots of suspension travel. If you lose traction you are really just guessing what is happening with the tires. Some feedback artifical or real has to be part of FFB to give that scary feeling of losing traction not just relying on visual and sounds. I hope that EVO focus to be really an evolution of car simulation, not just an update of AC1.

This game's physics are like no other i've tried, somehow Kunos have managed to find the perfect balance between a daily road car and a GT car's handling. Even on my standard budget sim setup there is just enough information coming through the wheel to immerse myself, i can feel the front dampers compressing into the corners and at the same time feel the rear stepping out when trailbraking.

There's something to be said about the graphics too, i'm on low-medium settings with nvidia DLSS and i struggle to spot any aliasing even when i try. The game isn't the most optimised as of now but that's given as it is still in early access with a new graphics model, yet there's some shots of these cars that look the most realistic out of any game i've been in and every so often the cars look like the ones out of Forza Horizon 5.

Overall this game is already amazing and given that this is the experience in early access, the full release will be great!
I shall wait for more cars and F1 cars and more tracks this game got potential
